tools.name: effect.info
tools.description: Summarise a motion-graphics project (.ecproj) in your workspace: its items with names, types, sizes, durations, and each composition's layer count and frame rate. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: effect.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the effect engine's catalog, in order, on the project (.ecproj) or Lottie file at `path` in your workspace, or on a new empty project, then write the project (.ecproj), a composition as Lottie (.json or .lottie; `comp`, `include_expressions`), or one frame (`comp`, `time` seconds) as a .png at most `max_side` pixels long (`transparent` keeps the alpha) to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document) and effects the engine builds in; anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the effect-engine skill first.
